Class Station

java.lang.Object
domain.Station
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class Station extends Object implements Serializable
Represents a station in the railway system with buildings, cargo management, and position validation capabilities.

    • getMap

      public Map getMap()
      Retrieves the map associated with the current station. The map is fetched from a repository of maps using the station's map ID. If the map ID is invalid or out of bounds, null is returned.
      Returns:
      the map object corresponding to the station's map ID, or null if the map ID is invalid.

    • setStationType

      public void setStationType(String stationType)
      Updates the station type using a string representation. The string is parsed to determine the corresponding StationType enum value.
      Parameters:
      stationType - the string representation of the station type. It should match the display name of a valid StationType. Case is ignored during comparison.
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the provided string does not match any valid station type.

    • setOrientation

      public void setOrientation(Station.Orientation orientation)
      Sets the orientation of the station.
      Parameters:
      orientation - the desired orientation of the station, provided as an Orientation enum value

    • setOrientation

      public void setOrientation(String orientation)
      Sets the orientation of the station using a string representation. The string is converted to an Orientation enumeration value.
      Parameters:
      orientation - the string representation of the desired orientation, which can be either the name of the enum constant or its display name. Comparison is case-insensitive.
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the provided string does not match any valid orientation.
